name: i-track
description: Eye-tracking desktop app with Electron + React + TypeScript

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder-config/build-config.json --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder-config/build-config.json --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder-config/build-config.json --mac
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder-config/build-config.json --win --mac
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder-config/build-config.json --publish always
